note: Every decoder an evaluator may score with, and what it was tuned on. Read by decoder_provenance.py, which eval_tf.py, rollout_eval.py, vae_gate_score.py and after_nexttic.sh use so every score names its decoder. A decoder tuned after 2026-09-22 carries its own provenance.json (finetune_decoder.py writes the exact episode ids) and needs no entry here. An unseen-map claim needs provenance 'recorded' with training episodes from seen-map training ids only, or provenance 'public'.

vae_decoder_arnold_lpips.recipe: finetune_decoder.py --in-dir raw_arnold --split split_arnold.json, MSE + 0.1 LPIPS, 50k cached frames, 100k presentations
vae_decoder_arnold_lpips.why_unknown: tuned before finetune_decoder.py recorded episode ids; raw_arnold is the 17-map corpus, whose training maps include arenas 6, 7 and 8 (docs/REVIEW_2026-09-22.md H4)
vae_decoder_arnold_lpips.unseen_map_claims: refused: scores made with it are 'unseen by the dynamics model' only

vae_decoder_sd35_lpips.unseen_map_claims: refused: scores made with it are 'unseen by the dynamics model' only
